added.summary: The track map at a top corner: the circuit as a light line over a dark road, the lap driven lit in the HUD's accent, the start line, the other cars as dots in their colours and the player's car as an arrow turned to its heading; the track's name and length under it. Smaller on a phone, without the length.
A boost meter (nitro, ERS): its picture, its name with the key that fires it, and a leaning bar cut into cells that glows while it fires.
Throttle and brake as two leaning upright wells filled from the foot, green and red, each named under it.

The car's condition: the tyres as tags two to a line inked by their wear (good, worn, bad), the fuel as a thin bar with the game's words that turns to danger with Fuel low, and a Box this lap tag when the team calls the car in.
Feedback over the road: a meter (the slipstream) as a word over a bar in the HUD's accent, and the points a drift or a chain earns, large and slanted, with what earns them in gold.

breaking.change: RacingTelemetry is one tachometer standing bare over the scene: a white rev arc with its red zone (lit once the revs reach it) round a dark glass face holding the shift lights, the speed, the units and the gear on a lit tag beside the gearbox's mode. New props mode, scale (keyed rows of { id, value, label }: the dial's figures and ticks) and lights (the share of the shift lights lit; negative hides them). The bar form and the boost ring are gone: props dial, boost, boostMax and boosting are removed. The Shift cue is a word beside the gear. Its parts are RacingTelemetry.frame, .dial, .track, .fill, .redline, .tick, .mark, .face, .lights, .speed, .units, .gear, .mode and .badge; .plate, .figure, .label and .caption are gone, and the frame's data-dial and data-boosting are gone.
breaking.fix: Drop dial, boost, boostMax and boosting from the RacingTelemetry tag and show boost with RacingBoost (value, max, firing). Pass scale for the dial's figures and lights for the shift lights. A style that dressed .plate or .figure dresses .gear or .speed; .label dresses .units; .caption is gone. Set the --hud-rev-*, --hud-redline* and --hud-dial-* tokens for the dial's look.

breaking.change: RacingLapHud stands bare over the scene as the race HUD mockup draws it: the place large and slanted over the field's size, the lap on a lit plate and the places gained beside it (new prop gained), then the current, last and best lap times and the split delta on a green or red tag beside the split's name (new prop sector). The split's sense is read with the delta, no longer a word drawn beside it, and the final lap reads on the lap plate. Its parts are RacingLapHud.frame, .place, .of, .lap, .gained, .times, .row, .label, .time, .delta and .badge; .readout, .title, .figure and .caption are gone. The Time label reads Current and the position's label Position.
breaking.fix: Pass gained (places gained since the start; 0 hides it) and sector (the split's name). A style that dressed .readout or .figure dresses .place, .lap or .time; .title and .caption dress .label.

breaking.change: RacingStandings is the position tower: one leaning glass row per car without a heading band, the place in a box, the car's colour on a stripe (new row field color), the name and the gap; the leader's empty gap reads Leader; the player's row is lit in the HUD's accent and no longer carries a You word; a retired car's tag reads DNF and its row dims. On a phone the tower keeps the leader and the rows either side of the player. title is now only read, not drawn. Its parts are RacingStandings.frame, .row, .place, .car, .name, .gap and .badge; .band, .title, .label, .figure and .caption are gone.
breaking.fix: Add color (a CSS colour, or empty) to each row. A style that dressed .band or .title drops it; .label and .figure dress .place or .gap; .caption (You, the empty line) dresses .row[data-player=true] or .badge. Name the player's row as the game wants it read (You).

breaking.change: RacingBanner's plate is the HUD's smoked glass with a lit top edge in the accent and the call in widely set capitals. New kind call shows the game's own words (new prop text: Final lap next, Sector best). The plate part is RacingBanner.plate alone (it no longer also wears RacingBanner.frame).
breaking.fix: A style that dressed the plate as RacingBanner.frame dresses RacingBanner.plate. Pass kind call with text for a call the kit does not word.
